sobre.title: ABOUT ME
sobre.bioP1: My interest in technology started early. Whenever I see a manual, repetitive process, I cannot resist trying to automate it. That curiosity took me from iPhone board repair to notary desks and back to technology.
sobre.bioP2: Today I work as a notary clerk at Cartório Gaya in Blumenau, Brazil. I found that I work well in the legal world, but I am always drawn back to technology: I try to improve or automate processes even when nobody asks.
sobre.bioP3: I build software using generative AI (Claude, GPT) as my primary tool, from LLM prototypes to back-end and front-end. I do not write every line from scratch; my work is to decompose the problem, structure the instruction, and connect the pieces until the entire flow works. That is exactly the engineering I want to do in production: put AI to work solving real problems.

roles.title: Founder & Builder — DocFácil
roles.description: A Next.js platform that generates legal documents through conversation. I built a provider-agnostic layer (`AIProvider`) with an environment-based factory, a server-side API route (`/api/ai/generate`) that keeps secrets on the server, response streaming, and typed error handling (`AIError`). Real providers (OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini) are pluggable without changing the rest of the app.
achievements: Guided chat interface with real-time document preview.
The AI layer is decoupled. Changing the LLM requires no front-end changes.

roles.title: Notary Clerk / Powers of Attorney Dept.
roles.description: I built an automation that consumes Detran-RS endpoints to generate vehicle powers of attorney automatically, eliminating repetitive manual entry. It remains in production at the notary office. A task that took minutes now takes only a few clicks.
achievements: Drafting powers of attorney, deeds, and estate inventories.
General network and hardware support and diagnostics.

roles.title: Apple Repair Technician
roles.description: Quickly promoted from intern to diagnostic technician.
achievements: Microsoldering, thermal diagnostics, and iOS board repair.
Parts inventory control and repair workflow organization.
Customer support focused on translating technical issues into clear answers.

docfacil.title: DocFácil — Generative AI for Legal Documents
docfacil.problem: Manual legal-document drafting is prone to inconsistencies and unnecessary bureaucracy.
docfacil.solution: Next.js 16 platform with an AI-provider-agnostic layer (`AIProvider`), server-side streaming, and pluggable OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini support.

atlas.title: Atlas Notarial — Detran-RS API Automation
atlas.problem: Manual vehicle power-of-attorney issuance required five minutes of data entry per document.
atlas.solution: Time reduced from 5 minutes to 20 seconds per document with 100% legal accuracy.
atlas.stack: Node.js · REST APIs · Notarial Automation · Vitest

ckf.title: CKF Maintenance — Quotes & Machinery
ckf.problem: No centralized control for issuing heavy-machinery maintenance quotes.
ckf.solution: React interface with Supabase, CSV/XLSX report exports, and an automated Vitest unit-test suite.

folilib.title: Foli — PDF Layout Engine in TypeScript
folilib.problem: Unexpected layout breaks and overflow when generating complex PDFs in Node.js and the browser.
folilib.solution: Fluent Builder API with a layout engine that guarantees zero overflow, native primitives, and Unicode support.
folilib.stack: TypeScript · PDF Engine · Open Source · Zero-Overflow
